items.title: New office lease
items.notes: The finance director reported on the offer for the second floor at 18 Wharf Road.
decisions: that the company enter into a five-year lease of the second floor at £46,000 a year, and that Priya Shah sign it for the company

items.title: Interim dividend
decisions: that an interim dividend of £0.12 per ordinary share be paid on 30 November 2026
